Name: JP's Debris Is In The Air - Eternal Lights
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]DIITA - Eternal Lights[/u][/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because who wouldn't want to live on a farm where it's always nighttime and you can't see anything without light sources? But the plants didn't think it was important. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=3]This mod allows you to modify the lighting of your current location through an in-game menu that is activated with the [b][color=#ffff00]“F8” key[/color][/b] (by default, but it can be changed to any other key or key combination!). Cool, right?
The change in lighting is accompanied by the corresponding ambiance (the night filter uses the nighttime ambiance and vice versa). 
There is a slight transition of colors throughout the day so that the filter does not feel monotonous. In addition, depending on the season, the filter varies in color. 
[/size]

[size=4][b]Everything is activated and deactivated through the menu or with GMCM for a more general option. [/b][/size]


[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
